text:
zyra: Postmortem follow-up thread for today's authz outage. Keeping it terse: primary causes identified were JWT leeway misconfig (clock skew handling), a policy-sync webhook timeout that dropped owner labels, audit-exporter OOM causing missing S2S events, and the rotation orchestration hitting the retry cap so a few envs missed secret updates. Need owners + short due dates so we can mark remediation as CLOSED.

zyra: Remediation bullets (short):
1) Harden JWT handling: explicit leeway and robust expiry coercion -> owner @matt.r -> 48h
2) Policy-sync webhook retry & owner label reconciliation -> owner @olivia -> 72h
3) Audit-exporter memory cap + backfill helper -> owner @infra-sre -> 72h
4) Rotation orchestrator: bump retry cap + add per-service reconciliation -> owner @qa-team -> 96h

matt.r: I'll take JWT. Plan: switch to deterministic int(exp) parsing, add +/- leeway check, unit + integration tests, small canary in staging. Example snippet I'll include in PR: 
```
exp_ts = int(float(jwt_payload.get('exp', 0)))
if now > exp_ts + ALLOW_LEEWAY:
    deny()
```

olivia: I'll own the webhook fixes. Add exponential backoff and a reconciliation job that re-applies missing owner labels from infra's canonical CSV. ETA 72h.

infra-sre: Audit-exporter: increase heap to 1.5G, add streaming backfill mode to replay dropped S2S events, and emit metric `audit.exporter.dropped_events` -> alert if >100/min. ETA 72h.

qa-team: Rotation orchestrator: raise retry cap to 10, add idempotent reconcile endpoint `POST /rotations/reconcile` and a healthcheck `GET /rotations/status`. We'll do rolling reconcile for affected envs first. ETA 96h.

zyra: Good. Please post a one-line accept here with an epoch due ts so I can wire reminders and update the remediation tracker. I'll add recurring checks for patterns as well (we've seen similar token + label drift clusters).

matt.r: :thumbsup: I accept 98 Due: 2005180321 (48h).

olivia: :thumbsup: I accept 98 Due: 2005266721 (72h).

infra-sre: :thumbsup: I accept 98 Due: 2005266721 (72h).

qa-team: :thumbsup: I accept 98 Due: 2005422721 (96h).

zyra: Two cross-cutting asks: (1) add owners + epoch due to the tracker sheet and paste the link here; (2) schedule a monthly "authz-patterns" review that surfaces JWT/perm/rotation regressions and rolling counts.

olivia: I'll push the label reconciliation CSV to the tracker and link it once PRs merge.

sec-bot: Reminders scheduled: T-24h and T-4h for accepted owners, alerts for `audit.exporter.dropped_events` will post to #incidents-alerts. Use `/remind` to change. :robot_face:

matt.r: Extra note: vulnerable behaviour reproduced when exp was encoded as float and code compared floats with `==`. I'll add the failing payload to the PR for future tests.

infra-sre: Backfill dry-run planned. Will post counts here before actual replay.

qa-team: We'll run reconcile in dry-run mode first and publish results.

zyra: Thanks all. Once owners confirm in the tracker I'll close out. Reopen if blockers.
